  • [Owner: your honest answer — how many years well-built plywood cabinets last in a Florida home, from your experience.]
  • Water, not humid air alone, is what ruins most cabinet boxes: leaks under the sink, dishwasher steam, and a home left closed without AC.
  • PalmCraft builds cabinet boxes from 3/4-inch plywood and finishes doors in its own spray booth in Oldsmar.

Why humidity matters for cabinets in Florida

Wood products take on and give off moisture with the air around them. In Tampa Bay, the air stays humid most of the year, so cabinet materials and finishes are tested every day, not just in summer.

[Owner: add what you see in Florida homes — where cabinets fail first.]

Plywood vs. particleboard vs. MDF

[Owner: check and expand with your own experience.]

  • Plywood: cross-laminated layers of wood veneer; holds screws well and is the material PalmCraft uses for cabinet boxes.
  • Particleboard: wood particles and glue pressed into a sheet; common in lower-cost and flat-pack cabinets.
  • MDF: fine fibers pressed into a smooth sheet; often used for painted doors and panels.

What shortens cabinet life

  • A slow leak under the kitchen or bathroom sink.
  • Dishwasher steam venting into the cabinet next to it.
  • A vacation or rental home left closed with the AC off.
